title: A newsletter that mentions a renewal is no loose end

messages.subject: March newsletter: spring renewal in the community garden
messages.body:
Hello gardeners,

This month the spring renewal of the community beds starts on Saturday 21 March: bring gloves and a spade. Our seed swap is on 28 March at the library, and our tip of the month is how to renew tired soil with compost. Membership renewals open next month; more in the April newsletter.

Happy gardening,
City Gardeners
